Based on my search results, I can provide you with information about the **Navy P-3**, which refers to the **Lockheed Martin P-3 Orion**, a long-range maritime patrol aircraft used by the U.S. Navy and other naval forces worldwide.

## Lockheed Martin P-3 Orion Overview

The **P-3 Orion** is a four-engine turboprop aircraft developed primarily for **maritime patrol and anti-submarine warfare (ASW)**. It has been one of the most widely recognized and longest-serving maritime patrol aircraft in military aviation history.

### Key Specifications:
| Feature | Specification |
|---------|-------------|
| **Manufacturer** | Lockheed Martin |
| **First Flight** | 1959 |
| **Service Entry** | Early 1960s |
| **Engines** | 4 × Allison T56-A-14 turboprop |
| **Power** | 4 × 4,600 shp (3,430 kW) |
| **Cruise Speed** | ~330 knots (610 km/h) |
| **Max Takeoff Weight** | ~142,000 lbs (64,400 kg) |
| **Crew** | 11 seats typical |
| **Unit Cost (1987)** | $36 million |

### Primary Missions:
- Anti-submarine warfare (ASW)
- Maritime patrol and surveillance
- Overland intelligence gathering
- Search and rescue operations

### Current Status (2025-2026):
According to the latest updates, the **U.S. Navy has significantly reduced its P-3 fleet**. As of October 2025, only **six active P-3 Orions** remain in U.S. Navy service:
- **VX-30** (test squadron): 4 aircraft
- **VXS-1** (scientific development squadron): 2 aircraft

The P-3 is being replaced by the **P-8 Poseidon**, a jet-powered maritime patrol aircraft based on the Boeing 737 airframe. The P-8 offers advantages including higher speed, greater sonobuoy capacity, and modern avionics.

### International Operators:
The P-3 continues to serve with several international navies, including:
- **Canada** (CP-140 Aurora/CP-140M variants)
- **Argentina** (receiving additional P-3C aircraft in 2025-2026)
- **Netherlands** (historical operator, now retired)
- **NOAA** (WP-3D variants for hurricane research)

### Notable Features:
- Based on the **Lockheed L-188 Electra** commercial airliner design
- Features a **high-wing configuration** and large internal **weapons bay**
- Can carry **torpedoes, depth charges, and various surveillance equipment**
- Known for exceptional **long-endurance** capabilities

The P-3 Orion represents one of the most successful military aircraft programs, with over six decades of continuous service across multiple nations.

---

Sources:
1. https://aerocorner.com/aircraft/lockheed-martin-p-3-orion/
2. https://www.p3orion.nl/news.html
3. https://bobistheoilguy.com/forums/threads/flynavyp3-p3-vs-p8.272816/
